templateSource.serialization: JSON.stringify(canonical(parsed template)); recursively sort object keys and preserve array order

requestWithoutTemplateBody.Description: Review only: original platform eleven owners, controller disabled and desired zero. Do not execute.

cloudFormationManagedReads.target: The exact eleven resource platform stack and metadata of its directly referenced existing template dependencies only, using existing Source-derived permissions.
cloudFormationManagedReads.externalDependenciesBoundBy: The exact templateSource SHA: VPC/two subnets, HTTPS certificate, task execution role, fixed database Secret reference and ECR image digest. Metadata only; no Secret values, SQL or other stacks.

writerPreflight.target: Exact stackId; compare UUID/status/last update/no explicit RoleARN/tags/outputs, parameter keys only; no parameter values persisted.
Exact stackId Original, hash must match original; no raw Environment/Command persisted.
Exact stackId, one complete page; compare all eleven existing CFN physical bindings.
Exact stackId, one complete page; stop on AVAILABLE/creating plan, name collision or NextToken; retain FAILED/old records, do not delete.
Exact expected platform cluster/service only, compare ARN/0 counts/:12 reference with bound receipt.

writerStatus.target: Only returned bound ARN; on uncertain ACK use exact new name plus exact stackId. IncludePropertyValues=true, no NextToken. Bounded state polling is not write retry.

independent.target: Exact bound ARN or unique approved name+stack, IncludePropertyValues=true, one complete page; confirm mode/status/template input/changes/Drift/IgnoredProperties.
Exact stackId and newly bound ChangeSetName ARN, TemplateStage Original; proposed body SHA must equal candidate.
Exact original stack identity/status/last update/RoleARN/tags/outputs unchanged; CFN-managed DriftInformation may update during creation and is recorded separately, not treated as a resource write.
Exact original stack, one complete page; all eleven old physical bindings remain unchanged.
Exact platform name remains absent, no resource restoration.
Exact original platform service still same ARN/:12 and 0/0/0.

risks: Only one unexecuted UPDATE/REVERT_DRIFT change-set record is authorized after explicit approval. No ALB, listener, task, DNS, IAM or database change is authorized; creating a record is not repair or deployment success.

The exact stack has no associated execution RoleARN in the bound observation. The request deliberately omits RoleARN; if that fact remains true, CloudFormation uses a temporary session derived from the existing Source user. The effective credentials may be broader than the template scope; no role or permission installation is authorized. Stop if an explicit role appears.

CloudFormation reads actual configuration for the eleven-resource stack and may validate metadata of its bound external VPC/subnets, HTTPS certificate, task execution role, fixed Secret reference and ECR image, using underlying service APIs. These internal calls cannot be capped by the local 24 metadata-call budget; network/provider audit logs and low nonzero fees remain. Secret values and database access are excluded. Existing validation/hooks are provider-managed, not permission for an agent to invoke a Lambda or mutate resources.

Detailed change-set property review and GetTemplate may place historical lease/parameter/Environment/Command and fixed Secret reference metadata into process memory. Persist only allowlisted safe projections and hashes in a private ACL directory; no raw context, credentials, Secret values, private keys, configuration files or business snapshots are saved to Git or printed.

Preflight, Create and independent inspection are non-atomic. Concurrent updates or permission/schema changes may invalidate the plan. Unexpected diff/ignored/write-only fields or pagination prevent acceptance, never trigger automatic Execute, fallback, IAM repair, deletion or a new slot.

An uncertain/failed Create may leave an unexecuted record while other retained resources or audit facilities can continue charging. Preserve it and all old records; no automatic retry, replacement, rollback or cleanup. Status timeout does not cancel provider processing. If acknowledgement is uncertain, inspect only the exact approved name and stack within reserve.

Historical HostingExpiresAt tags and controller lease parameters are retained unchanged; this approval neither renews them nor disables existing cleanup. Source fact timestamps and five-hour endpoint are not reset. Resource billing can continue elsewhere and 50 USD/month is not a hard cap. Later paid ALB restoration, task-definition replacement/retirement and normal CFN rollback require separate execution approval.

sources.purpose: Exact UPDATE request, omitted role behavior, tags and DeploymentMode.

nextAfterCreation: Independently classify the real unexecuted ARN and drift/property proof. A successful create does not authorize Execute; unexpected changes remain unexecuted and preserved. Prepare any execution/failure-policy/ALB-cost approval separately.
